title: Call for Justice: Cigarette Smoke Memories
content:

    Location: North Sector Living Room

Yup, I'm done. My work here's done~...


	

Wait. Where are you going.

Where? Back to my room. Snacks are ready for the next "Kid's Space", so I guess my work's done.

We still need to taste them.

Eughh, is that really called for. Unless somthin' major happens, we shouldn't have to remake em right...

No, I was saying I'll treat you to a some tea or coffee as a thanks for helping-

...?


	

Are you back, Ren?

What an unusual sight...
Eugh...

What's wrong?

Aah, yer also bad with sweets huh? I guess yer room's flooded by the scent of buttercream now.

Is that so? Are you feeling sick...?

That's how it feels for guys who don' like sweets.

... I'm going to my room.

Poor guy. I also get sick around those sickly-sweet scents too, so I get how it feels.

Soo, I'll leave the tasting to you. After work beer is the best after all...♪

Wait.

Wh-what.... do ya really need a taste test that badly?

That's enough. That scent reminded me, you should fix that cigarette stench.

Eeh?

I don't think you should be allowed to come to the "Kids Space" reeking of cigarettes. Deal with it before we get complaints from the parents.

... Is it that bad?

Mhm. That's how it is for people who don't like that scent.

Guh...


    Location: Rooftop

Fuu...


	

(A smoke at this time's the best...)

(... The scent of cigarettes huh...)

(I don't usually think 'bout this kinda thing but, do they reek that much?)
(... I don't get it. Dino and the rookies haven't really said anything 'bout it.)

(Is Marion just oversensitive to scents? There aren't many smokers around here so...)

(Well... maybe, smokers or cigarettes themselves leave a bad impression.)

(When I was in the Academy, teachers would get on my case a lot, digging through my stuff cuz it smelled like cigarettes.)
(They'd say "Where have you hidden them".... I guess that's when they started keepin' an eye on me, to the point where they'd get suspicious of anything and everything I'd do?)

(The smell of cigarettes really came from my dad, cuz his smoking infected all my things. I didn't like the scent too-)
Hm?

...!


	

Ooh, is that Ren? How long've you been there?

... I just got here.

I see. What's up? Come to stargaze?
I also came to look at em. Despite looks, we're actually romantics huh.

...

Oi, I'm joking. Say something.

... Well, I'll go back to smokin, don't worry yerself 'bout it.

...

Ah my bad. Is the smoke in yer face?

...

(Oh jeez... will this be a repeat where he'll get the urge to dash or glare at me cuz of that "scent".)

I don't hate the smell.

Eh?


	

... My dad used to smoke occasionally.
It wasn't that frequent though...

Heeh...

Mom and Neesan disliked it so, he made sure not to smoke often.
On clear days, he'd sit in this chair in the garden, reading a book or the newspaper; just like today, where you can gaze at the beautiful starry sky.

I didn't dislike it, I got the impression he was the kind of adult who enjoyed luxury goods.

...

... I've said too much. Forget about it.

So that kinda trope exists too huh.

?

Ooh, don't worry 'bout it. Forget 'bout it too.

...

Wanna try a smoke?

No thanks, I wouldn't smoke.

Haha, I know.

...

Aah... I said I'd go back after a smoke but, can I have another?

Whatever, I don't mind.

Thanks.


	

...

...
